sinopsis.es: Luis y Ana van a conocer al bebé de sus amigos. La visita se vuelve incómoda cuando tanto los padres como el recién nacido empiezan a comportarse de manera extraña.
sinopsis.en: Luis and Ana visit another couple of friends who have just had a baby. What promises to be a quick visit with the sole purpose of meeting the newborn ends up turning into a strange experience that reveals that neither the parents are as fine as they claim, nor the baby as normal as he seems…
